wikipediaDecision: The five representative links were verified earlier. The remaining 34 candidate profiles were all checked: 30 now link to retrieved Wikipedia articles (including clearly labeled couple/related-topic pages where appropriate); 4 retain wikipedia=null because no exact matching person article was found. The no-match outcomes distinguish two unidentifiable Alexander entries, the Ephesian silversmith Demetrius (only the generic name article was found), and Crispus (the retrieved article is the 4th-century Caesar, not the Corinthian synagogue leader). Each of the 34 has an evidence/person_1 Wikipedia article-check record; none is marked not-checked.
